messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

The vault does not rank oscilloscope opportunities in Aerospace / Defense, so the strongest supportable answer is to prioritize opportunities where the vault directly maps UAV functions to R&S RTO / R&S MXO and separately shows UAV military / aviation / defense demand and test context [50][12][13].
### 推薦先賣
| Opportunity | Why it is evidence-backed | Supporting evidence | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV image / video interface validation around camera and image-processing modules | UAVEcoChain maps the UAV “影像處理-相機” category to companies such as 邑錡, 圓剛, 聰泰科技, 亞光, 聯詠, 華晶科, 智動航科, 瑀豐股份 and 台灣彩光; 邑錡 is specifically marked with GMSL and LVDS and mapped to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [45]. | The Taiwan UAV eco-chain source lists Key component / technology companies including image-processing and video-related companies, and UAVEcoChain further maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [40][50]. | The same source says these R&S mappings must not be rewritten as a formal configuration guide, sold opportunity, customer adoption, certification or test result [50]. |
| UAV motor / gimbal electronics and battery / power electronics debug | UAVEcoChain maps “馬達動力雲台” to companies including 其昜先進, 六俊電機, 八達創新, 力山工業 and 世紀民生, with 其昜先進 mapped to R&S MXO; it also maps “電池電源” to 德鑫新技, 台船動力, 其昜先進 and 有量科技, with 德鑫新技 mapped to R&S MXO [45]. | The broader drone solution proposal lists drone components including battery, BMS, ESC, Flight Control Module, Communication Module, antennas and sensors, which supports a drone electronics test context [13]. | The source does not provide product models, formal specs, customers, supply relationships, shipments, certifications, tenders, revenue or market share for most UAV supply-chain rows [43]. |
| UAV / UAS EMC and EME test adjacency, especially military / aviation drones | The 2025RS Drone Solution is centered on EMC / EME and says drone / UAV / UAS face different electromagnetic interference and test needs in residential, outdoor AUT, MIL battle environment and multi-domain operations [13]. | The same source proposes UAV / UAS Drones T&M Solutions including standard systems R&S TS9975 EMI Test System, R&S TS9982 EMS Test System and R&S TS8997, plus customized directions such as B-RID Environment Performance, CUAS System Performance Verification, Electromagnetic Environment Emulation and High-Intensity RF [13]. | The vault does not directly tie R&S RTO or R&S MXO to the EMC / EME proposal; the proposal also lacks test method, frequency plan, chamber / antenna setup, pass / fail criteria, threat waveform and safety conditions for the customized items [15]. |
| Military / aviation drone standards-driven troubleshooting and pre-compliance support | The drone solution proposal lists Aerospace / Defense-relevant standards and test lines including MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, DEF STAN 59-411, GJB 151B and GJB 1389A [13]. | The same source says MIL-STD-464 covers system-level topics including external RF EME, HPM, EMP, lightning, RADHAZ, HERP / HERF / HERO, electrical bonding, TEMPEST and platform radiated emission [13]. | The source is a Market-class proposal, not a MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464 or RTCA DO-160 standard document, and it cannot be used to decide which drone / UAV / eVTOL product must perform which tests [11]. |
| High-speed PCB / signal-integrity workflows for defense electronics suppliers and system houses | R&S PCB test solutions are documented for PCB Fabricator and System House workflows including Material Measurement, Material / Stackup selection, Signal Integrity modeling / testing, Sampling testing and PL / Process Monitoring [29]. | The measurable items listed include TDR impedance, DK / DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling and eye diagram [96]. | The vault does not directly connect this PCB / SI workflow to Aerospace / Defense customers, and the slide does not provide fixture, frequency, standard, instrument model, S-parameter format, control limits or acceptance conditions [28][30]. |
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO / R&S MXO | UAV image-processing / camera interfaces, specifically GMSL and LVDS in the UAVEcoChain mapping [45]. | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, channel count, memory depth or order number for R&S RTO / R&S MXO in this UAV mapping [45][50]. | The vault directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [50]. | [45][50] | The mapping cannot be treated as a formal configuration guide, sold opportunity, customer adoption, certification or test result [50]. |
| R&S MXO | UAV motor / gimbal and battery / power categories in UAVEcoChain [45]. | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, channel count, power-analysis option or order number for R&S MXO in these rows [45][50]. | The vault directly maps 其昜先進 in motor / gimbal to R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 in battery / power to R&S MXO [45]. | [45][50] | The source does not provide test conditions, product models, customer requirements, acceptance criteria or evidence of sales adoption [43][50]. |
| Oscilloscope for PCB / SI workflow | PCB Fabricator and System House workflows around TDR impedance, DK / DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling and eye diagram [96]. | 知識庫未標示 an R&S oscilloscope model or option for the PCB workflow [30]. | The workflow contains oscilloscope-adjacent measurement needs such as TDR impedance and eye diagram, but the vault does not directly bind those needs to a named oscilloscope product in the cited PCB source [96][30]. | [96][30] | No Aerospace / Defense customer link is stated for this PCB workflow in the passages [29][30]. |
| Oscilloscope within UAV EMC / EME debug support | Military / aviation drone EMC / EME test context includes EMI / EMS, RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning induced transients and ESD topics [13][14][69]. | 知識庫未標示 an oscilloscope option or specification for EMC / EME testing in the drone proposal [77][79]. | The opportunity is only adjacent because the vault confirms A&D drone EMC / EME needs but does not map R&S RTO / R&S MXO to that proposal [13][77]. | [13][77][79] | The proposal lacks formal date, version, author and multiple test-method details, and it cannot be used as a formal compliance guide [15][78]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing suppliers | R&S RTO / R&S MXO where the account has GMSL / LVDS validation needs [45][50]. | Start from 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS because this is the clearest direct RTO / MXO mapping in the vault [45][50]. | The vault does not provide bandwidth, channel count, probe selection, compliance method or customer adoption evidence for the RTO / MXO mapping [50]. |
| UAV power, battery and motor-control suppliers | R&S MXO for rows where UAVEcoChain maps motor / gimbal or battery / power companies to MXO [45]. | Start from 其昜先進 and 德鑫新技 because they are the named MXO-linked rows in motor / gimbal and battery / power categories [45]. | The vault does not provide specific waveforms, voltage / current ranges, safety requirements, acceptance limits or a confirmed purchase plan [43][50]. |
| Military / aviation drone integrators and EMC labs | Use the oscilloscope discussion as an adjunct to EMI / EMS and system-level EME conversations, not as a proven configured EMC solution [13][77]. | The A&D context is supported by military / aviation drone EMC standards and system-level EME topics including MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464 and RTCA DO-160 [73][79]. | The vault does not directly state that R&S RTO / R&S MXO are part of the 2025RS Drone Solution standard system, which lists R&S TS9975 EMI Test System, R&S TS9982 EMS Test System and R&S TS8997 instead [77]. |
### 限制
The clearest direct oscilloscope-related evidence is the UAVEcoChain mapping of 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO, and of selected motor / gimbal and battery / power rows to R&S MXO [45][50].
The broader Aerospace / Defense demand evidence is strongest for UAV / UAS, military / aviation drone EMC / EME, and Taiwan UAV market / procurement context, but those sources do not by themselves prove oscilloscope fit, configuration or customer adoption [12][13][16][18][50].

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980

- 可作 one-box testing setup。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming
[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 22 — Lightning Induced Transients
來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 25 — Electrostatic Discharge
來源說此測試確保 equipment able to withstand an air discharged electromagnetic pulse，並指出 static electricity charges can result from human contact；contributing factors include low humidity、low temperature、low conductivity、carpets、vinyl seats and plastic structures。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 來源列出的 sections
| Section | 來源描述 |
|---:|---|
| 15 | Magnetic field / magnetic effect。 |
| 16 | Power input（electrical testing, non-EMC）。 |
| 17 | Voltage spike（AC / DC）。 |
| 18 | Audio frequency conducted susceptibility - power inputs。 |
| 19 | Induced signal susceptibility。 |
| 20 | Radio frequency susceptibility（radiated and conducted）。 |
| 21 | Emission of radio frequency energy。 |
| 22 | Lightning induced transient susceptibility。 |
| 25 | Electrostatic discharge。 |

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 15 — Magnetic Effect
來源說 Section 15 concern 為 equipment magnetic effect，目標是 finding or proving the closest distance to compasses or compass sensors（flux gates）at which that unit is allowed to be installed。

來源列出 classification：Cat Y、Cat Z、Cat A、Cat B、Class C，其中 Cat Y 被描述為 equipment next to navigation compass，Class C 被描述為 equipment >3.0 m from navigation compass。來源未提供完整 category definition。

來源的 RF electromagnetic environment 章節列出：

- emulate complex EME signals。
- enable the military electromagnetic spectrum operation。
- emulating different electromagnetic environment。
- evaluating military system level effects under EM interferences。
- simulating different operational scenarios。

這支持 [[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 的客製化測試方向，但來源未提供 signal library、scenario definition、threat emitter model、功率、頻段、同步或安全條件。

The broader Aerospace / Defense demand evidence is strongest for UAV / UAS, military / aviation drone EMC / EME, and Taiwan UAV market / procurement context, but those sources do not by themselves prove oscilloscope fit, configuration or customer adoption [12][13][16][18][50].

- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。

- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。

- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

- [[UAV]] — 來源定義為 platform vehicle。
- [[UAS]] — 來源定義為 entire system that supports drone operation，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等。
